verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents one-click templates, starter repos, or a deploy button for common use cases. Blueprints (a single render.yaml file defining the architecture) and the ClickHouse deployment guide are adjacent infrastructure-as-code and how-to material, not one-click templates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases
